buildCommand: /bin/sh -c 'd=$(pwd); i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 6 ]; do if [ -f "$d/build.sh" ]; then exec /bin/sh "$d/build.sh"; fi; p=$(dirname "$d"); [ "$p" = "$d" ] && break; d=$p; i=$((i+1)); done; echo "Set the Vercel Root Directory to the repository root, not build/web"; pwd; ls -la; exit 1'
installCommand: /bin/sh -c 'if [ ! -x "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" ]; then git clone --depth 1 --branch stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"; fi'
